lpx.chooseTitle.en: Choose the title these ads promote

lpx.noTitles.en: No title of this company is on CrazyDramas yet. Upload one from the CrazyDramas page; it then appears here.
lpx.noTitles.zh: 这家公司还没有剧集上传到 CrazyDramas。在 CrazyDramas 页面上传后，剧集会出现在这里。

lpx.state.notLive.en: not live: preview will refuse it

lpx.state.notChecked.en: not checked yet: preview checks it
lpx.state.notChecked.zh: 尚未检查：预览时会检查

lpx.state.readFailed.en: last read failed: preview checks again
lpx.state.readFailed.zh: 上次读取失败：预览时会重新检查

lpx.buttonLinkLabel.en: This ad opens an Instant Page. Its button opens this link, which ends with each campaign's own campid (the first campaign's is shown)
lpx.buttonLinkLabel.zh: 这条广告打开即时页面。页面按钮打开此链接，链接末尾是每个广告活动自己的 campid（此处显示第一个广告活动的）

lpx.macroNote.en: TikTok replaces __CAMPAIGN_ID__, __AID__ and __CID__ with the campaign, ad group and ad ids when someone taps the ad; crazydramas records the visit under them.
lpx.macroNote.zh: 有人点击广告时，TikTok 会把 __CAMPAIGN_ID__、__AID__ 和 __CID__ 替换为广告活动、广告组和广告的 ID，crazydramas 按这些 ID 记录访问。

lpx.campidTikTok.en: The tag names each TikTok campaign ({names}); it is not added to the link.
lpx.campidTikTok.zh: 该标记用于命名每个 TikTok 广告活动（{names}），不会加进链接。

lpx.campidInstantPage.en: The tag names each TikTok campaign ({names}) and ends that campaign's Instant Page button link.
lpx.campidInstantPage.zh: 该标记用于命名每个 TikTok 广告活动（{names}），并加在该广告活动即时页面按钮链接的末尾。

lpx.eventHint.en: TikTok delivers toward this crazydramas.com pixel event. Purchase is the goal; switch to InitiateCheckout while an ad group gets too few purchases to learn.
lpx.eventHint.zh: TikTok 会朝 crazydramas.com 的这个像素事件优化投放。以购买为目标；若广告组购买太少、难以学习，可暂时改为发起结账。

lpx.attributionFixed.en: 7-day click · 1-day view, sent when the ad group is created (TikTok never lets it change).
lpx.attributionFixed.zh: 点击后 7 天 · 浏览后 1 天，创建广告组时一并发送（之后 TikTok 不允许修改）。

lpx.pixelServer.en: The pixel is crazydramas.com's. Preview checks it is shared with every chosen ad account.
lpx.pixelServer.zh: 像素为 crazydramas.com 的像素。预览时会检查它是否已共享给所选的每个广告账户。

lpx.defaultPreset.zh: （默认）· 网站购买 · 购买 · 每天 $30

lpx.webLine.zh: TikTok 归因（{attribution}），不是 crazydramas 自己的统计

lpx.webUnavailable.zh: 暂时无法读取 TikTok 归因的购买数据：{reason}

lpx.defaultAccountNone.en: Not set: Launch starts with no ad account picked.
lpx.defaultAccountNone.zh: 未设置：投放页不会预先选中广告账户。

lpx.defaultAccountHint.en: Launch preselects it for every company whose Business Center (or assigned account) reaches it. Other companies choose as before.
lpx.defaultAccountHint.zh: 对于 Business Center（或指定账户）能用到该账户的公司，投放页会预先选中它；其他公司照常自行选择。

lpx.reachedByNone.en: No company's assignment reaches it yet; link its Business Center to a company below.
lpx.reachedByNone.zh: 目前没有公司的分配能用到它；请在下方把它所在的 Business Center 关联到公司。

lpx.pixelHandSet.zh: 手动设置 · 像素 ID {id}

lpx.pixelUnverified.en: Pixel ID {id} is set by hand; TikTok can't confirm it yet because the pixel permission is still waiting for TikTok's approval. The launch uses it anyway; the first paused launch is the check.
lpx.pixelUnverified.zh: 像素 ID {id} 是手动设置的；像素权限还在等 TikTok 审核，所以 TikTok 暂时无法确认它。投放照常使用这个 ID，第一次暂停状态的投放就是检验。

lpx.pixelUnverifiedOwned.en: Pixel ID {id} is set by hand; TikTok can't confirm it yet because the pixel permission is still waiting for TikTok's approval. The launch uses it anyway; the first paused launch is the check. The pixel is owned by {bc} — confirmed through the Business Center.
lpx.pixelUnverifiedOwned.zh: 像素 ID {id} 是手动设置的；像素权限还在等 TikTok 审核，所以 TikTok 暂时无法确认它。投放照常使用这个 ID，第一次暂停状态的投放就是检验。该像素归 {bc} 所有，已通过 Business Center 确认。
